page.layout: One printed page, blank, on a scanned book leaf held in a book cradle; the digitiser's credit line sits in the black band at the bottom and is not transcribed.
page.notes: Blank leaf with no printed text, no page number, no running head, no catchword and no signature. Visible are only paper tone, a few small spots and specks, the page edges and the book cradle with its clamps. The digitiser's credit line (Early European Books, ProQuest, Biblioteca Nazionale Centrale di Firenze, CFMAGL 1.6.317) is excluded as not printed on the page.
